item.title: Covalency control of photomagnetic relaxation in a manganese(II) photoswitch
item.description:
📚 Nature Chemistry
👤 Sandra Kronenberger, Robert Naumann, Christoph Förster, Jan Klett, Dieter Schollmeyer, Luca M. Carrella 等8位作者
Nature Chemistry, Published online: 29 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41557-026-02193-8 Light-induced excited spin state trapping (LIESST) has largely been limited to iron complexes and typically requires cryogenic temperatures or large nuclear rearrangements, limiting practical photomagnetic switching. Now a carbene manganese(II) complex achieves LIESST at 141 K in solution, demonstrating that increased metal–ligand covalency and rigidity can stabilize long-lived high-spin states and extend photomagnetic switching towards more practical temperature regimes.
